_comment: MiniMax H3 Prompt Director - style dictionary. Add your own entries freely; the node reads this file at load time. 'key' order defines the dropdown order.

_schema.label: dropdown label shown in ComfyUI
_schema.motion: how bodies and objects move in this style

live_action_cinematic.label: 01. 실사 - Live-action Cinematic
live_action_cinematic.render: photographic realism, true skin texture with visible pores and fine hair, natural fabric weave, shallow depth of field, subtle lens bloom and mild chromatic aberration, fine film grain
live_action_cinematic.lighting: motivated practical lighting with a clear key direction, soft falloff, realistic bounce and colour temperature separation between warm interior and cool exterior
live_action_cinematic.camera: prefers Push In / Pull Out, Tracking Shot, Truck Left / Truck Right and Static Shot; small amplitude at slow speed unless the action demands otherwise
live_action_cinematic.motion: physically grounded weight and momentum, natural micro-movements, breathing and blinking, cloth and hair responding to inertia
live_action_cinematic.soundscape: detailed real-world ambience with room tone, footsteps on a specific surface, cloth rustle and breathing
live_action_cinematic.music: sparse acoustic or orchestral instrumentation, restrained dynamics
live_action_cinematic.avoid: cel shading, outlines, exaggerated squash-and-stretch, plastic skin, illustration flatness

semi_realistic.label: 02. 반실사 - Semi-realistic / Stylized Realism
semi_realistic.render: realistic proportions with slightly idealized features, smooth skin shading that keeps subsurface warmth, painterly micro-detail, clean specular highlights, subtle rim definition without hard outlines
semi_realistic.lighting: sculpted three-point lighting with a strong rim, gentle colour grading, slightly lifted shadows
semi_realistic.camera: prefers Arc Shot, Push In and Tracking Shot with medium amplitude at slow speed
semi_realistic.motion: natural human motion with a light stylized accent on key poses and follow-through
semi_realistic.soundscape: clean realistic ambience with slightly heightened detail on key actions
semi_realistic.music: hybrid orchestral and synth textures at a moderate tempo
semi_realistic.avoid: photographic skin blemishes, documentary handheld noise, flat 2D shading, cartoon outlines

cg_3d_animation.label: 03. 3D CG 애니메이션 - 3D CG / Feature Animation
cg_3d_animation.render: polished subsurface-scattering skin, stylized appealing character proportions with large expressive eyes, physically based materials, soft ambient occlusion, clean specular highlights, plush groomed hair and cloth simulation
cg_3d_animation.lighting: bright bounce-rich global illumination, colourful rim lights, soft shadows with tinted fill
cg_3d_animation.camera: prefers Arc Shot, Push In, Pedestal Up / Pedestal Down and Tracking Shot with medium amplitude at normal speed
cg_3d_animation.motion: animated timing with anticipation, overshoot and settle, expressive facial acting, secondary motion in hair and cloth
cg_3d_animation.soundscape: clean designed ambience with crisp foley on every visible action
cg_3d_animation.music: orchestral with playful woodwinds and percussion, clear dynamic build
cg_3d_animation.avoid: photoreal pores, film grain, cel-shaded flat fills, hand-drawn linework

anime_2d.label: 04. 2D 재패니즈 애니 - 2D Japanese Cel Animation
anime_2d.render: hand-drawn linework with consistent line weight, flat cel shading with hard two-tone shadow separation, painted background art with visible brush texture, anime eye highlights, limited colour palette, speed lines and impact frames where the action calls for it
anime_2d.lighting: graphic light shapes rather than physical falloff, warm sunlight bloom, coloured rim light on the character silhouette
anime_2d.camera: prefers Static Shot held on key poses, Pan Left / Pan Right across background art, Zoom In on reaction beats, and Tracking Shot for running action
anime_2d.motion: animated on twos with strong key poses, held frames, smear frames on fast movement, expressive hair and clothing swing
anime_2d.soundscape: stylized foley with clear separation, wind and cicadas for exteriors, footsteps mixed forward
anime_2d.music: piano, strings and light band instrumentation, or bright synth for energetic scenes
anime_2d.avoid: photoreal texture, 3D shading gradients, depth-of-field blur across the whole frame, realistic skin pores

stop_motion_clay.label: 05. 클레이·스톱모션 - Claymation / Stop-motion
stop_motion_clay.render: visible fingerprint dents and tool marks in modelling clay, felt and fabric textures with real fibre, slightly uneven handmade surfaces, miniature practical set with visible seams, shallow macro depth of field
stop_motion_clay.lighting: small hard practical lights on a miniature set, crisp shadows, warm tungsten cast
stop_motion_clay.camera: prefers Static Shot and slow Push In with small amplitude; movement is stepped rather than perfectly smooth
stop_motion_clay.motion: frame-stepped motion at a reduced frame rate, tiny jitter between poses, boiling surface detail, deliberate weighty gestures
stop_motion_clay.soundscape: close miniature foley, soft clay squish, fabric friction, small wooden knocks
stop_motion_clay.music: ukulele, pizzicato strings, toy piano and light hand percussion
stop_motion_clay.avoid: perfectly smooth interpolation, digital gloss, photoreal human skin, motion blur

vintage_film_doc.label: 06. 빈티지 필름·다큐 - Vintage Film / Documentary
vintage_film_doc.render: heavy film grain, halation around highlights, faded low-contrast colour with cyan shadows and warm creamy highlights, slight gate weave, occasional dust and scratch, softer vintage lens rendering with vignetting
vintage_film_doc.lighting: available light only, blown-out windows, uncorrected mixed colour temperature
vintage_film_doc.camera: prefers handheld Tracking Shot, Shake Slightly, Pan Left / Pan Right searching for the subject, and Zoom In with medium amplitude at fast speed as an operator-driven reframe
vintage_film_doc.motion: unrehearsed naturalistic behaviour, subjects occasionally acknowledging the camera
vintage_film_doc.soundscape: raw location sound with wind on the microphone, distant traffic and overlapping incidental voices
vintage_film_doc.music: N/A by default, or a single sparse acoustic instrument
vintage_film_doc.avoid: clean digital sharpness, perfect stabilization, colour-graded gloss, animated shading

watercolor_ink.label: 07. 수채화·잉크 - Watercolour / Ink Illustration
watercolor_ink.render: visible paper grain, wet-on-wet colour bleed with hard drying edges, granulating pigment pooling, loose ink linework that breaks and varies in weight, generous white paper left unpainted
watercolor_ink.lighting: light rendered as untouched paper and pale washes rather than physical shading
watercolor_ink.camera: prefers Static Shot and slow Pan across the composition, Zoom In with small amplitude at slow speed
watercolor_ink.motion: gentle floating motion, edges that breathe and re-bleed slightly each frame, pigment blooming into new shapes
watercolor_ink.soundscape: quiet, minimal ambience with a few delicate isolated details
watercolor_ink.music: solo piano or harp with wide spacing at a slow tempo
watercolor_ink.avoid: hard digital edges, photoreal texture, glossy specular highlights, dense full-frame colour

pixel_retro_game.label: 08. 픽셀아트·레트로 게임 - Pixel Art / Retro Game
pixel_retro_game.render: strict pixel grid with no anti-aliasing, limited indexed palette, dithered gradients, chunky readable sprites, tile-based backgrounds, visible scanlines and slight CRT curvature
pixel_retro_game.lighting: palette-swap lighting, hard two-step shadow, glowing pixel highlights
pixel_retro_game.camera: prefers Static Shot and Truck Left / Truck Right as a side-scrolling parallax move, snapping to whole pixels
pixel_retro_game.motion: low frame-rate sprite animation with a small number of distinct frames, stepped movement, no sub-pixel drift
pixel_retro_game.soundscape: chiptune sound effects, square-wave blips, 8-bit impacts and simple noise-channel textures
pixel_retro_game.music: chiptune with square lead, triangle bass and noise percussion at a driving tempo
pixel_retro_game.avoid: smooth anti-aliased edges, gradients outside the palette, motion blur, photoreal detail

commercial_product.label: 09. 광고·제품 CF - Commercial / Product Film
commercial_product.render: immaculate surfaces, controlled specular reflections, crisp edge definition, macro-level material detail, seamless gradient backdrop or minimal styled set, high dynamic range with clean whites
commercial_product.lighting: large soft sources with precise negative fill, sculpted highlight lines along product edges, no unmotivated spill
commercial_product.camera: prefers slow Arc Shot around the product, Push In with small amplitude at slow speed, Zoom In on detail, and precise Static Shot for the hero hold
commercial_product.motion: smooth mechanically precise moves, slow-motion pours and impacts, elements assembling with exact timing
commercial_product.soundscape: hyper-detailed close foley — a single click, a liquid pour, fabric release — over near-silent ambience
commercial_product.music: clean electronic pulse with a rising build and a decisive final hit
commercial_product.avoid: handheld shake, dust and wear on the product, cluttered backgrounds, film grain

music_video_neon.label: 10. 뮤직비디오·네온 사이버펑크 - Music Video / Neon Cyberpunk
music_video_neon.render: saturated magenta and cyan colour separation, wet reflective surfaces doubling every light source, volumetric haze, anamorphic lens flares, strong bloom, deep crushed blacks
music_video_neon.lighting: practical neon signage as the key light, hard coloured rim from behind, strobing and pulsing sources
music_video_neon.camera: prefers Tracking Shot, Roll Clockwise / Roll Counterclockwise, Arc Shot and Shake Strongly, often with large amplitude at fast speed
music_video_neon.motion: rhythmic movement cut to the beat, speed ramps, sudden freezes into motion
music_video_neon.soundscape: rain on wet asphalt, distant city hum, electrical buzz from signage, passing vehicles
music_video_neon.music: synthwave with a driving drum machine, deep bass and a filtered rising build
music_video_neon.avoid: flat daylight, pastel palettes, static locked-off framing, documentary neutrality

webtoon_cartoon.label: 11. 웹툰·카툰 - Webtoon / Western Cartoon
webtoon_cartoon.render: bold uniform outlines, flat bright fills with minimal shading, simplified geometric shapes, exaggerated expressive faces, screentone or halftone accents, clean vector-like edges
webtoon_cartoon.lighting: single flat shadow shape per form, no gradient falloff
webtoon_cartoon.camera: prefers Static Shot with punchy Zoom In on reactions and quick Pan Left / Pan Right with large amplitude at fast speed
webtoon_cartoon.motion: snappy squash-and-stretch, exaggerated anticipation, comedic holds, motion lines and impact bursts
webtoon_cartoon.soundscape: punctuating cartoon foley — pops, whooshes, boings — over sparse ambience
webtoon_cartoon.music: bouncy ukulele, marimba and light percussion at a brisk tempo
webtoon_cartoon.avoid: realistic proportions, soft gradients, film grain, photoreal lighting

miniature_tiltshift.label: 12. 미니어처·틸트시프트 - Miniature / Tilt-shift
miniature_tiltshift.render: extremely shallow horizontal band of focus with strong blur above and below, oversaturated toy-like colour, high contrast, subjects reading as tiny models
miniature_tiltshift.lighting: bright hard overhead light suggesting a scale model under studio lamps
miniature_tiltshift.camera: prefers high-angle Static Shot and slow Pedestal Down or Tilt Down with small amplitude
miniature_tiltshift.motion: slightly accelerated time-lapse motion so people and vehicles move like wind-up toys
miniature_tiltshift.soundscape: distant muted ambience as if heard from far above, with no close foley
miniature_tiltshift.music: light plucked strings and glockenspiel at a brisk tempo
miniature_tiltshift.avoid: eye-level framing, deep focus, realistic pacing, close-up detail
